messages.body_plain:
Dear Traminer Users,

I would like to examine the mean within cluster and mean between cluster
distances for each cluster solution calculated by the wcKMedRange as in the
command below.  Can any explain how I might do this?

Thanks,

Jeremy

pam <- wcKMedRange(mvaddist, kvals = 2:10, weights = mvad$weight)
